exposure: intralesional triamcinolone acetonide delivered via needle-free electronic pneumatic jet injector
cohort: Eleven children (5-17 years old) with keloids and hypertrophic scars who received intralesional triamcinolone acetonide treatments using an electronic pneumatic jet injector.
finding: Needle-free electronic pneumatic jet injector-assisted triamcinolone acetonide treatment significantly reduced scar scores, was well-tolerated with less pain than needle injections, and resulted in high patient satisfaction among children.
